items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I’ve heard Kenny Berger – Kenny Berger told me that Joe is a cold fish.

ctx.x: As was Lew, as is Hubert. That makes a difference. That’s why you – that’s great. I don’t remember that gig. But this was – Joe didn’t say a word to me. I don’t know if Joe was just the way he was. I don’t know anything about him.
I’ve heard Kenny Berger – Kenny Berger told me that Joe is a cold fish.

It appeared that way, but maybe it was personal. He didn’t like me. I don’t know. The only time I got anything out of Joe was – and it was heavy, because it kind of determined the course of my life. In this period, he called. Again, the phone. “It’s Joe Farrell,” Elena, “Joe.” He goes, “I got a double at the Plaza, Sunday night.” Something like that. No hello, no nothing. “Double,” meaning, “I got something else. Do you want to take my place?” The Plaza Hotel. You know what that means. That’s top. That’s tuxedo.…
